docs.title: ChatHFD 文档
docs.text:
ChatHFD 使用 HF-Mirror 和 aria2c 下载公开 Hugging Face 模型与数据集。先通过 setup 检查下载引擎，再通过 download --dry-run 预检文件和大小。

  • CLI 树

    查看 setup、download 的真实参数和安全边界。

    查看 CLI 树

  • 下载模型与数据集

    README 示例 展示 Qwen 模型的小型配置文件和 MathArena 数学数据集；默认源为 HF-Mirror，超过 10 GiB 需明确放行。

docs.title: CLI 树
docs.text:
此页基于真实 chathfd --tree 输出。ChatStyle 将公开根名固定为 chathfd；--tree-brief 只省略子命令参数签名。

chathfd
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
├── download <REPO-ID> [--repo-type REPO-TYPE] [--revision REVISION] [--endpoint ENDPOINT] [--local-dir LOCAL-DIR] [--include INCLUDE] [--exclude EXCLUDE] [--connections CONNECTIONS] [--jobs JOBS] [--dry-run] [--allow-large]  # Download a public model or dataset with aria2c.
└── setup [--install]  # Check the aria2c download engine and offer installation.

chathfd --tree-brief 的子命令行：

├── download  # Download a public model or dataset with aria2c.
└── setup  # Check the aria2c download engine and offer installation.

docs.title: 下载边界
docs.text:
setup 检查本机 aria2c，缺失时给出安装指引；setup --install 需再次确认才会尝试安装。download 支持公开 Hugging Face 模型和 --repo-type dataset 数据集；默认 https://hf-mirror.com，可用 HF_ENDPOINT / --endpoint 覆盖。--include / --exclude 限定文件，--dry-run 预检大小，超过 10 GiB 需要 --allow-large。--jobs 和 --connections 分别设置并发文件数和每文件连接数。只按大小校验，不支持 gated/private 仓库 Token。完整示例与 ModelScope 区别见仓库 README。

更新 CLI 时先更新 Click 注册面及测试，再运行真实 chathfd --tree 和 chathfd --tree-brief 回填本页及 README。

docs.title: ChatHFD Documentation
docs.text:
ChatHFD downloads public Hugging Face models and datasets using HF-Mirror and aria2c. Check the engine with setup, then preview file selection and size with download --dry-run.

  • CLI Tree

    Review the real setup and download commands, options, and safety boundaries.

    View CLI Tree

  • Models and Datasets

    README examples show a small Qwen model config and a MathArena math dataset; the default source is HF-Mirror, and selections over 10 GiB require explicit opt-in.

docs.title: CLI Tree
docs.text:
This page mirrors the real chathfd --tree output. ChatStyle fixes the public root name to chathfd; --tree-brief only omits command parameter signatures.

chathfd
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
├── download <REPO-ID> [--repo-type REPO-TYPE] [--revision REVISION] [--endpoint ENDPOINT] [--local-dir LOCAL-DIR] [--include INCLUDE] [--exclude EXCLUDE] [--connections CONNECTIONS] [--jobs JOBS] [--dry-run] [--allow-large]  # Download a public model or dataset with aria2c.
└── setup [--install]  # Check the aria2c download engine and offer installation.

The command line in chathfd --tree-brief is:

├── download  # Download a public model or dataset with aria2c.
└── setup  # Check the aria2c download engine and offer installation.

docs.title: Download boundary
docs.text:
setup checks for aria2c and suggests a package-manager command if missing; setup --install requires explicit confirmation before attempting installation. download supports public Hugging Face models and datasets (--repo-type dataset). The default endpoint is https://hf-mirror.com; HF_ENDPOINT or --endpoint overrides it. Select files with --include / --exclude, preview with --dry-run, and opt in to selections over 10 GiB with --allow-large. --jobs controls concurrent files and --connections connections per file. Verification is by size only; gated/private tokens are not supported. See the repository README for examples and the ModelScope distinction.

When updating the CLI, change Click registration and tests first, then rerun chathfd --tree and chathfd --tree-brief to refresh this page and the README.
